variants.name: Error
variants.summary: A run the origin timed out: the danger status, the outcome in danger color, the function and origin nodes tagged Failed and Timed out, the failing origin-response span selected in the trace with its message, and the warning lines in the logs.

variants.name: Running
variants.summary: A run still in progress: a loading Running status, Replay disabled, Completed reading Not yet, the function and origin nodes tagged Running and Waiting, the spans running in the trace and the lines printed so far kept on screen, with a loading Streaming `StatusIndicator` in the Logs header.
